elements.name: convolution
elements.brief: Applies a row-major 3x3 convolution kernel to `src` and writes the result
elements.description:
Applies a row-major 3x3 convolution kernel to `src` and writes the result
into `dst`. Both buffers must carry a uint8 `rgb` stream of three or four
components per pixel, and must hold the same byte count — the call raises
an error otherwise.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.doc: The destination buffer the result is written into.

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Width of the image in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Height of the image in pixels.

parameters.name: kernel
types: [ number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number ]
